tagline: Mechanistic pruning experiments for separating compression that preserves general perplexity from compression that preserves reasoning circuits.
research_question: Why does dense-shaped magnitude masking preserve Mistral-7B GSM8K reasoning at 20% sparsity while 25%+ masks and structural MLP-width pruning degrade despite similar C4 perplexity?

overview.title: What we're building
overview.body: A structured pruning + activation healing pipeline (TIM-MGDT) that identifies which transformer layers and MLP widths are elastic, critical, or reasoning-specific. The current focus is Mistral-7B compression that survives GSM8K rather than merely preserving C4 perplexity.

overview.title: Why this matters
overview.body: Phase 16 showed the central failure mode: 20% hardware-aligned width pruning kept C4 perplexity in a plausible range but collapsed 5-shot GSM8K from 38.7% to about 5%. That is a useful negative result because it separates general language retention from reasoning-circuit retention.

overview.title: Where we are today
overview.body: Phase 19 validation. Uniform structural width pruning collapses GSM8K even at 1%, but dense-shaped magnitude masks preserve reasoning at much higher sparsity. The strongest current positive control is 20% mask sparsity with 37.2% full GSM8K versus 38.7% dense.

decisions.rationale: We shifted focus to Mistral-7B and Llama-3-class architectures, where compression failures are meaningful for modern reasoning deployments.
Phase 18B and Phase 19 now form a controlled contrast: C4-matched structural and masked models can have very different GSM8K retention.
To ensure theoretical FLOP reductions translate to physical speedups, we round pruned MLP dimensions to nearest 64 (Tensor Core alignment) via specific ceil/floor strategies.

tasks.next_action: 20% mask full GSM8K is strong at 37.2% strict EM versus 38.7% dense; 25% drops to 34.0%, making 20% the safe point and 25% the first full-test boundary failure.
Initial mask-guided structural pruning failed: 0.45% and 0.89% MLP sparsity reached only 24% and 10% GSM8K smoke, so larger points are stopped by default.
The 20% mask is close to dense on GSM8K Platinum smoke and above dense on BBH multistep arithmetic smoke; keep this as support, not the primary claim.

Use COLM Efficient Reasoning as the technical target, but confirm remote or proxy presentation before committing to that venue because the workshop page says hybrid while the COLM FAQ is in-person-first.

bulletproofing.item: Multi-GPU OOM errors structurally prevented by parallelizing inference and sequentializing gradient bounds.
C4 perplexity, throughput, and full GSM8K metrics extracted for Phase 16.
20% mask pruning completed full GSM8K validation within 1.4 points of dense.
Develop a structural method that preserves the Phase 19 mask-retained reasoning subspace while creating real speedups.

path_to_paper.item: Phase 19: Full GSM8K confirmed the 20% mask-vs-structural control.
Phase 16: Established the negative result: 20% MLP width pruning drops GSM8K from 38.7% to roughly 5%.
Phase 17/18: Keep the smoke-test failures as evidence, but do not invest more full-eval compute in those exact variants.
Tighten `paper/main.tex` around the final Phase 19 boundary: 20% retained, 25% degraded, 30%/40% collapse further.
Email the COLM Efficient Reasoning organizers to confirm whether accepted workshop contributions can be presented remotely or by proxy.
Final paper review and submission to the strongest venue whose presentation policy is compatible with travel constraints.
